title: New Energy Supply Risk Alert
pain: Tiered supplier information is fragmented and risk signals lag, making it hard for procurement and production planning to respond in time.
value: Building supplier profiles and a risk-signal radar to help management identify supply disruption, price volatility and compliance risks earlier.

title: Multi-Channel Demand Forecasting for FMCG
pain: Channel promotions, seasonality and new product launches amplify forecast error, leaving inventory and stockouts side by side.
value: Integrating sales, campaigns, channels and external factors to give regional teams explainable forecasts and replenishment recommendations.

title: Procurement Cost-Saving Opportunity Identification for Manufacturers
pain: Historical procurement data is hard to accumulate; category opportunities, price anomalies and supplier concentration risks cannot be identified quickly.
value: Automatically generating category analysis, price trends, supplier comparisons and cost-saving opportunity lists to support procurement decisions.
